name: Apple Home Devices
summary: Brings your Apple TVs into your home.

pairingLost.words: It needs to be paired again

repair.help: Pair it again. The TV shows two codes, one after the other.

airplayCode.label: Code on the TV (1 of 2)
airplayCode.help: The TV shows a four-digit code.

companionCode.label: Code on the TV (2 of 2)

refusals.expired: That code had expired. Enter the new one on the TV.

companionCode.help: A new code is on the TV.

refusals.notAllowed: The TV refused pairing. On the TV, open Settings, then AirPlay and HomeKit, and allow access to everyone on the same network.
refusals.unreachable: The TV couldn't be reached. Check that it's plugged in and on the same network, then add it again.
